From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@microsoft.com>, Dave Lang <dave.lang@bluestone.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Partner Center — account certification & seller sync for BlueStone Analytics

Team — looping you both in to set a short sprint to get BlueStone certified in Partner Center and lock the owner mapping before next week's co-sell review. Summary / ask: 

- Background: BlueStone is in the tail end of a POC and wants list/co-sell support. Microsoft needs Owner/PC evidence and an explicit seller alignment in Partner Center (they flagged missing owner at intake).
- Goal: get Partner Center referral accepted with an owner and evidence uploaded by May 28 so MS can route co-sell leads next quarter.
- Proposed owners: Jordan (field SDR liaison) + Karthik (partner ops) as owners in the map; Vanessa to own the certification packet and sources of truth.

Attached: bluestone_account_map_v1.xlsx (proposed mapping), pc_referral_evidence.pdf (POC slides + SOW snippet). I also sketched a one-week sprint plan in the sheet. 

Immediate asks:
1) Vanessa — can you validate the evidence checklist (I marked required items in the PDF) and confirm what we still need?
2) Karthik / Jordan — can you confirm the Partner Center account alias to use for owner assignment and whether Jordan can be the field seller contact in the PC referral?
3) Priya — can you confirm the exact acceptance criteria MS will use on Partner Center for this account and any timing constraints?

Target next touch: quick sync Tue 5/25 10:00 PT (15 minutes) — please advise if that works.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Attachments: bluestone_account_map_v1.xlsx, pc_referral_evidence.pdf

Thanks Hannah — short notes below: 

- Saw the sheet, looks mostly good. One ask: the current evidence PDF is missing the signed DPA page; BlueStone legal said they'll send today. Without that PC will mark 'incomplete' for compliance.
- I recommend we make Jordan the default field seller in the referral but set Karthik as the operational owner (that avoids reassigning later). I'll own the evidence bundle + the DocuSign link.
- Timing: Tue 5/25 10:00 PT works for me.

Quick edits I made in the sheet: added a doc checklist column, and a 'hold / go' column for items that require MS confirmation.

Vanessa Ortiz

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@microsoft.com>

Cc: PC Support <pc-support@microsoft.com>, Dave Lang <dave.lang@bluestone.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center — account certification & seller sync for BlueStone Analytics

Hi team — thanks for the packet. Two clarifications from the Partner Center side: 

1) Acceptance criteria: we need a named seller (email), a signed DPA (or redacted excerpt), and either a SOW or 3 slide POC summary showing technical fit.
2) Owner semantics: Partner Center will accept both a 'Partner contact' and a 'Field seller' entry. For co-sell routing we need the field seller email to be a Microsoft identity (microsoft.com). If Jordan won't have that, list a Microsoft alias and we can map to their MR.

I checked the intake: current referral is missing the DPA and the field seller email. Once those are uploaded we can requeue the referral and expect routing in 5–7 business days.

I'll join Tue 5/25 10:00 PT to confirm once you upload.

— Priya Rao
Partner Sales, Microsoft One Commercial Partner
priya.rao@microsoft.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Thanks all — short sync notes and actions from this morning: 

- BlueStone legal uploaded the signed DPA to the drive and I moved it into the evidence packet. See Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3C-BS-account-cert
- Jordan has confirmed he'll be the primary field seller contact; Microsoft alias to use for routing is ajay.mr@microsoft.com (Priya, please map to Ajay MR).
- Karthik will set the Partner Center owner to 'Redwood - Karthik Iyer' and flagged the owner ID in the spreadsheet (see attached owner-certification-template.docx).
- Next steps: Vanessa to upload final evidence bundle to Partner Center intake by EOD 5/27, Priya to requeue intake and confirm routing ETA.

I'll update HubSpot once intake is requeued: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DEAL-2027-4187

Thanks — small sprint but should get co-sell routing enabled for next quarter.

Hannah
